title: Under the Fold of Wool

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The bundle comes in on the arm and is covered. The flail comes down and the grain comes out smaller than it went in, and no slate is opened over it. Winnow it, cover it again, go around the empty place in the returning line: what is kept is kept by being covered, and the count of it stands nowhere. Ask the pot. The pot has no figures.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Vail kiln-house, kept over the dressing of the first grain

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and twenty-five to two hundred and twenty-seven days, six months and forty-five days to six months and forty-seven days, carried everywhere and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing --- a cost asked as a direction answered with the pot and the weather, the carrying arm as a record in muscle that knows weight and not cost, the first grain beaten out of the ear and taken apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set on a place of its own, the private file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing --- without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no hearing beyond six, no seventh of the full note, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no fifth telling of the burned slate, no third telling of the counting room shut in the war, no fourth likeness made a cause, no third gap, no opening, no calling of the loan, no payer named, no private record read, no figure given for the dressed grain or for the hand that did not come back, no eighth green or shape, no name spoken over either, no betrayal paid and no ending

scenes.title: The Hand Laid Down Again
scenes.synopsis: First entry, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap: Day 225, Grain 16, Sixthday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the flagstones and the Clay Yard. No recap: the hand lies down against the fold after the two-rhythm letting-go, and that coordination is set down like a tool, not recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that, with the sour Ash breath of the unswept corner the house calls the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. The boy is two hundred and twenty-five days old and six months and forty-five days and nobody says so (T071/T072); the carried fire gives four low pulls and withholds its fifth, its payer unnamed for two hundred and twenty-five days (T088); the river's note of water over water through the finger's-width door, the fire's gap under the floor and the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot are three counts in three places that do not become one, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). One leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. The file is turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of a person and no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying and the fourth burned-slate telling on their own places, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Grain's first reading and the true subtraction in Berr's locked box, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth with twenty-four honest answers --- a twenty-fifth is filed this morning, up an inch and down at once under conditions that had once answered, an honest miss and not a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment or a power (T061/T082, T036/T076). Sella comes to the fire before the basket, gives every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, says the house and The house will keep it, goes wide around the pan's gone ring, the bare trough, the rack space with broken birth-slates, the field's empty place and the returning-line place with a look and a wide step and no number; lips along the two-gapped row with no figure; eye once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and hand shut half over nothing without a touch; finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread; pot rim set with handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched, no opening in forty-five days, private roll unshown, Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100, T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced and not paid). The first grain lies covered near the hearth under wool, entered on no slate, given no figure. A neighbour at the door asks what the dressing of the grain will take and is sent to the pot and the weather; a man off the clay road brings a number up out of a fist and puts it back in his sleeve (T077). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust from men unnamed before first grey, speaks to the wheel and a pot, withholds the full note, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition, not a change made again; he's not Vail sealed, the promise ungiven, the burned-slate word still four and the shut-room tellings still two (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, keeps the seventh at the lip, the ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping, nine with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled and no collector in the road; his stroke goes over the shallow bright patch without the half-check; the warm stone stays cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Grain 10 is a morning behind and Grain 20 (Day 229) is three mornings ahead; neither brought early.

scenes.title: What the Flail Brought Out
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 225, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the flagstones at the yard's edge, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, gathered and not paid: the year's first cut grain is taken out of its covering, beaten out on the flagstones with a wooden flail and winnowed so that the chaff goes up on the river wind; the dressed grain is poured back near the hearth and covered again under the wool. It has changed from bundle to dressed grain and has gained no figure: counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm's weight, entered on no slate, a pot covered and kept by being covered (T077, T060/T086, T071/T072). The boy takes it apart as he takes apart everything within two paces --- what it is, grain; where it stood, in the worked strips east of Low Kiln; who paid a figure for it, nobody under any roof; what it asks of him, nothing --- and files it on a place of its own, not across the two unnamed shelf gaps, not across the fold's one crust and its empty place, not across the pan's gone round ring or the field's empty place (T060/T086/T097). With the hands dressing the grain the yard goes around the empty place in the returning line where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, with a look and a wide step and no number --- no name, cause, accident, body, identification, figure or payment; T098 advanced and emphatically NOT paid, held for the far-off day a body is found or a figure is given, never a third gap, a fourth likeness, a cause or a name. Five walked-around things stand in a row and a row is not an account until a payer stands under it, and none does (T009/T013/T092). Sella with her back to the basket: lips along the two-gapped row, no figure; jar-glance and hand half-shut; finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal stays unread, uncounted and uncopied; fire told the thaw and coals turned with the back of a broken pot; The house will keep it; count under the breath toward no opening; grey streak pale as she pushes hair back with the burn-wrist; pot handle two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched at an afternoon and a dusk, no opening in forty-five days (T058/T079, T100). Garl kept in objects without a story: salt-stiff coat with the crease at the left shoulder, the seat's twenty-year hollow and lean, the clean dark line with its finer grey called the thaw unswept, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack, the tile debt circled without a name and worse for being uncalled, his name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-five days (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn announces six where the house can check and holds the seventh where it cannot, the unforged collector sentence beside the knife, the ear-sentence stopped short of the calling word as a remembered stopping, no collector on Grain 16, the stroke past the bright patch without the half-check, the stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Jorra parts slate dust from slip as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, keeps dusty and clean forearms on one tray, gives the men no name, lets three shapings of the pot saying stand as sayings with no pot lost and no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, and grows quieter when the burned-slate word goes around (T035/T031, T061/T082, T065/T095). In the small hours, with Sella gone to her own bed and the two rooms not touching, the boy asks his hand: it goes up an inch toward the note and is held for the small intake only and comes down before the letting go --- a twenty-sixth honest answer, filed on the sixth place with nothing laid across it and no payer named, an interval and not a reach, a hearing, a seventh or a power (T061/T082). Exact final image: the dressed grain re-covered near the hearth with the chaff gone into the river wind, the fold left flat with its one crust and unnamed empty place, and the yard still going around the returning-line place with a look and no number --- the two keepings not laid together.

scenes.title: The Second Working Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 226, Grain 17, Seventhday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the flagstones, the yard well and the wheel-shed edge. New day, new date, no recap: two hundred and twenty-six days old, six months and forty-six days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and twenty-six days (T088); fire, river and boards keep three counts in three places (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow; first sound the kiln in fours with a gap, no bell and no market. The second working morning of the dressing: the dressed grain is spread thin to finish drying on the flagstones and turned by a woman's hand that reads it by weight, still in glances and handfuls and never in a figure (T077). A rack woman at the well with slip dried pale in the creases of her wrists asks what the storing will take and Sella sends her to the pot and the weather with Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it; a man off the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve so the figure arrives nowhere (T077). Grain's changed arithmetic goes on unread under the roof: printed one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read on Grain 10 still not the figure paid, the true subtraction locked in Berr's box going up toward High Kiln, Hessa's narrow slate gone up unread toward Greybank, the soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge for a measure nobody called --- all held in the boy's file and none reached back (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held). The seventh green is a colour and the seventh shape a shape on places that do not touch, now seven mornings gathered, with no eighth of either, no second look joined, no name spoken over either, no loaf, no slate and no sale, neither woman nor child called Fenna or Ulda in the narration, neither promoted into a hearing, a cause or a romance (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough whose water is called weather, the field's empty place and the place in the returning line, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, not paid). Sella at the shelf with her back to the basket: lips along a two-gapped row and no figure, jar-glance and hand half-shut on nothing, finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal stays unread, fire told the thaw, coals turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, count under the breath toward no opening, grey streak pale as she pushes hair back with the burn-wrist, pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with the half-beat and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched since before the kiln on Ember 1, no opening in forty-six days, private roll unshown, Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100). Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, tells the kindling Six counted. The next I don't count, keeps the seventh at the lip, the ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping, nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled and no collector on Grain 17; his stroke goes past the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, gives the men unnamed before first grey no name, lets one of the three pot sayings stand on a wrong wind with no fourth likeness made a cause, and puts his bent finger into the damper ahead of Sella's sentence as a remembered repetition; the burned-slate word stays at four and the two shut-room tellings stay two (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). In the small hours the boy asks his hand: it goes up an inch and comes down before the counted breath has finished --- a twenty-seventh honest answer filed on the sixth place, not a longer reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment or a power (T061/T082). Exact final image: the clay jar cold under its glaze on the wall shelf with Sella's hand shutting half over nothing without a touch, while the dressed grain lies thin on the flagstones under its own keeping, the two keepings not joined and no figure over either.

scenes.title: A Wrong Wind over the Flagstones
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 226, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the flagstones, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending; heat settles under the low angle of the loaf shelf, behind the pot and into the fold where one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lies two inches from the ear and keeps its empty place unnamed; no third comes; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody performs. The dressed grain is turned once more on the flagstones and the chaff that was winnowed out goes on the river wind and is entered by nobody; what is kept is kept by being covered and the count stands nowhere (T077, T060/T086). A kiln-hand come up off High Kiln on a wrong wind lets one of the three shapings of the pot saying stand over the boards --- a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw --- and the boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and leaves it a saying about a pot, with no fourth likeness made a cause, no lesson, no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and no pot lost (T061/T082, T064). The burned-slate word goes over the boards still a fourth telling out of Slate Row and a direction arrived nowhere, not a fifth and not a third telling of the room shut in the war (T065/T095). The yard goes around the returning-line place again with a look and a wide step and no number; no name, cause, body, figure or payer, and the absence gathers interest without being paid (T098). The sweetish green edge of lead glaze comes up on the wrong wind, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it: a direction, not a second edge paid, and the seventh green stays a colour on its own place with no eighth (T064, T050/T051 held). Sella with her back to the basket: two-gapped row with no figure, jar-glance and hand half-shut, finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal stays unread, fire told the thaw, coals turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, count under the breath toward no opening, grey streak pale, pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with the half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched at an afternoon and a dusk with no opening in forty-six days, private roll unshown and Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100). Garl kept in objects: salt coat, hollow seat, clean dark line with its finer grey unswept, proverb gone to the pot with no crack, tile debt neither paid nor settled nor named, no lesson and no collector, his name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-six days (T009/T013/T092). Tarn at the kindling: Six counted. The next I don't count, the knife at the very edge, the unforged sentence beside it, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered stopping, nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 unspent, the loan uncalled and no collector; his stroke over the flagstones past the shallow bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn (T036/T076). Jorra parts dust from slip and keeps the knowing of the pot's near-full note on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, with the burned-slate word making him quieter and the household straightening around the quiet without an order (T061/T082, T035/T031). At the going of the light Sella carries him home at the half-pace with woodsmoke before her in long low bars and river wind behind, goes wide around every walked-around place, sets the basket on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face and leaves the thread frozen; the dressed grain and the first grain's empty place do not become one keeping. In the small hours, with no breathing number anywhere in the house, he asks his hand: it goes up an inch toward the note with no count anywhere to hold it against, stays for the river's own low interval, and comes down on the next low note --- a twenty-eighth honest answer, one rhythm and no second, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a payment or a power (T061/T082). Exact final image: the dressed grain spread thin on the flagstones with the chaff going off on the river wind, the river's note coming through the finger's-width door, and the hand coming down on the river's next low note --- nothing standing up out of it as a rule.

scenes.title: The Third Morning of Dressing
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 227, Grain 18, Eighthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the flagstones, the yard well, the wheel-shed edge and the worked strips' edge. New day, new date, no recap: two hundred and twenty-seven days old, six months and forty-seven days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and twenty-seven days (T088); fire, river and boards keep three counts in three places (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that; first sound the kiln in fours with a gap, no bell and no market. The third working morning of the dressing: the dressed grain is gathered up off the flagstones by the handful, poured back into its cover near the hearth and set down, dressed and stored, a keeping by being covered; the arms know its weight and not its cost, the yard counts it in glances and handfuls and nobody gives a figure, no slate is opened and no hand enters it (T077, T060/T086, T071/T072). The harvest has moved one physical step from cut to covered to dressed and stored, and has not become an account. A neighbour at the door asks what the storing will take now the grain is under wool, and Sella sends the question to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, and the figure arrives nowhere (T077). Grain 20 (Day 229), the second Account-day and market, is two mornings ahead and is not brought early; the printed figure stands unchallenged, the figure read on Grain 10 is still not the figure paid, the true subtraction stays locked in Berr's box, Hessa's slate stays up the road unread and the soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the landing for his uncalled measure (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough, the field's empty place and the place in the returning line where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out --- each with a look and a wide step and no number, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced and NOT paid). Sella at the shelf with her back to the basket: lips along a row with two unnamed gaps and no figure, eye once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and hand shut half over nothing without a touch, finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, fire told the thaw, coals turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, count under the breath toward no opening, grey streak pale off the coals as she pushes hair back with the burn-wrist, pot rim set with handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with the half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched with no opening in forty-seven days, private roll unshown and Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100). Garl kept in objects, his name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-seven days: salt-stiff coat, hollow seat with its leftward lean, the two unswept lines, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack, the tile debt circled without a name and worse for being uncalled, no lesson and no collector (T009/T013/T092). Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, tells the kindling Six counted. The next I don't count, keeps the seventh at the lip where the house cannot check, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name as a remembered stopping and not a new one, draws the Seed 16 breath and does not spend it, counts nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, keeps the loan uncalled, and no collector comes up the clay road on Grain 18; his stroke goes over the shallow bright patch without the half-check and over the road a house sends a man down when it wants a collector without once turning along it; the warm stone lies cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger from men unnamed before first grey, speaks to the wheel before anyone and tells a pot You'll do, withholds the near-full note with air under it and a want in it, lets the three pot sayings stand as sayings, and holds his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition, not a change made again; he's not Vail stays sealed, the promise of the boy's name neither given nor withdrawn, the burned-slate word still four and the shut-room tellings still two (T035/T031/T062, T061/T082, T065/T095). In the small hours the boy asks his hand: it goes up an inch toward the note, is held for the length of the river's own low interval and comes down short of the next low note --- a twenty-ninth honest answer filed on the sixth place, an interval stopped short and not a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a tenth stopping, a payment or a power (T061/T082). Exact final image: the dressed grain covered again near the hearth under its fold of wool with no figure over it, the pot rim set out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, and the boy lying two inches short of it with the thread at his mouth frozen and unwiped.

scenes.title: What the File Kept of Grain
scenes.synopsis: Sixth entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 227, Grain 18, Eighthday, afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending; heat settles under the low angle of the loaf shelf, behind the pot and into the fold where one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lies two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread at his mouth has frozen in the dry heat and is unwiped because nobody under the Vail kiln-house roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold has come to cheek and temple and the small bare joint at the wrist where the wool rides back and stopped there as if it had reached the end of an order written out for it; the afterdrop waits on the far side of a warming nobody in this house will perform. Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and keeps the fifth, its payer unnamed for two hundred and twenty-seven days; through the finger's-width door the river holds its note of water over water, a fifth low thing never counted among the hearings; overhead the boards keep four nails, four and a thumb-width knot. Three counts in three places and none rises into another, because a man who wanted them to agree would have to put a payer under all three and no payer stands to any (T088, T061/T082). The dressed grain stays under its covering near the hearth, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm's weight and entered on no slate; the yard has gone around the returning-line place with a look and a wide step and no number, and no name, cause, body, figure or payment stands under it (T077, T098 advanced and not paid). Sella with her back to the basket: lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, jar-glance and hand shut half over nothing, finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, uncounted and uncopied, fire told the thaw, coals turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, count under the breath toward no opening, grey streak pale as she pushes hair back with the burn-wrist, pot rim set with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with the half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, widow's mark hung where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Ember 1 and at no hour since --- no opening in forty-seven days --- private roll unshown, Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100). Garl kept in objects and not a story: salt-stiff coat with the crease at the left shoulder, the seat's twenty-year hollow and lean, the clean dark line with its finer grey called the thaw unswept, the proverb gone years ago to a pot with no crack, the debt against a firing of tiles neither paid nor settled nor named and worse for being uncalled, no lesson and no collector, his name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-seven days (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed and told the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, set the knife at the very edge with six where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot and Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there with no figure and no name as a remembered stopping and not a new one, counted nine behind it with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the breath from Seed 16 at the top of the reach and did not spend it and kept the loan uncalled; no collector came up the clay road on Grain 18; his stroke went over the flagstones past the shallow bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn; the warm stone lay cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and under the nails, white in the creases where a fist had opened and not bone-coloured slip; he kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray and parted them as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, asked neither which slate had been broken nor whether it was a birth-slate, gave the three or more men who went low into the back room before first grey no name and did not say the room was cold, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You'll do, knew the near-full note it would give and kept it back on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, let the three shapings of the pot saying stand as sayings with no pot lost and no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, and when her voice went low his bent finger went into the cold iron of the damper and held until the sentence reached the pot, then moved a hair's breadth and was left standing --- a remembered repetition, not a change made again; he's not Vail stayed sealed, the promise of the boy's name neither given nor withdrawn, the burned-slate word at four and the two shut-room tellings at two (T035/T031/T062, T061/T082, T065/T095). At the going of the light Sella carried him home at the half-pace, woodsmoke before her in long low bars and river wind behind with the taste of water over water, the carrying arm a record in muscle that remembers weight and not cost; in the Clay Yard she went wide around the clean dark line and the finer hairline called the thaw, the round ring where the shallow clay pan had stood, the bare dark trough whose water is called weather, the rack space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the field's empty place and the place in the returning line where the hand had gone in and not come back, each with its look and its wide step and its no number; she set the basket on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen; the dressed grain near the fire and the place in the returning line did not become one keeping. In the small hours Sella had gone to her own bed and left the coals to keep themselves, and the two rooms did not touch. He turned out the file as a man lays instruments on a towel --- no towel, no instruments, no case, but the order of the laying the whole of the discipline --- and found it exact, complete and worth nothing. Six hearings of the full note stood beside and never among: five from four sources and the sixth, the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt as the men lifted her, from a person; no seventh came in two hundred and twenty-seven days and none was invented to fill the empty place, for an empty place kept empty is a finding and a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged. Three near-full answers stood on their own tray, advanced and unpaid, and beside them three shapings of the pot saying and the fourth burned-slate telling, all sayings and directions arrived nowhere, no fifth telling of the slate, no third telling of the shut room, no fourth likeness made a cause. Beside the hearings but never among them the seventh green was a colour and the seventh shape a shape, gathered seven mornings ago on places that do not touch, with no eighth of either, no second look joined, no name spoken over either, no loaf, no slate and no sale, six greens behind a seventh making a row of greens and six shapes behind a seventh making a row of shapes, and a row not an account until somebody finds a payer to stand under it, and none stood under either (T050/T051, T033/T034 held). The told bell lay beside the heard, four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself; the told figure lay beside the paid, one in twelve read twice over a basket on Grain 10 and still not the figure paid, the true subtraction locked in Berr Clay's box going up toward High Kiln, Hessa Rale's narrow slate gone up unread toward Greybank, the soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge for a measure nobody called; none of it reached back under the roof to be opened, copied or paid (T078, T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held). The nine stoppings stood on Reed 5, 8, 11, 14, 17, 20, 23, 26 and 29 as objects and not a rule, with no payer named to any and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, and the seventh year stood at its very end and had not given; the Seed 16 breath was unspent and the loan uncalled; three held changes stood on three places --- the Day 161 fraction at the damper, the Day 166 beat beneath the shelf and the Tallow 22 half-check on the flagstones --- with the loft-sill scrape on a fourth, the pale line on the carried man on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth with thirty honest answers on it, the thirtieth gathered tonight; no payer named to any and nothing standing up out of them as a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a key, a power or a rule (T036/T076, T061/T082, T100). He put the question to his hand. It went up an inch toward the note of water over water through the finger's-width door, and stayed. In the other room her breaths had gone small intake, hold, letting go at her fire, a count she kept toward no opening and had never offered to any ear under this roof; the wall stood between that count and his ear and he did not hear it and was not asked to. He took the hand through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of those counted breaths, kept it through the little silence after her count had ended and brought it down on the river's next low note. Two rhythms, one held against the other across a wall that does not touch, remembered, not a change made again: not a longer reach, not a miss entered, not a hearing, not a seventh of the full note, not a tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end, not a payment, not one of the three held changes, not a key, not a power and not a rule. He filed it on the sixth place with no payer named and did not spend it and did not explain it; exactness and humiliation are one motion in a small hand and both are true and neither is a sign, for once he reduced a shoulder in the dark by feel alone and now he cannot close the two inches to the pot handle, lift his chin two inches to the crust or speak a number that anybody under any roof would be asked to believe. Two hundred and twenty-seven stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath; the carried fire's fifth was unpaid for two hundred and twenty-seven days; the seventh year stood at its very end and had not given; the seventh green was a colour and the seventh shape a shape, gathered and unjoined. Grain 20 stood two mornings ahead, the second Account-day and the market, and was not brought early into these small hours. The crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread at his mouth was frozen and unwiped, and the dressed grain lay covered near the fire with the place in the returning line still gone around and still without a number. Fire went on in the room that warmed him and the river in the room he could not enter, and neither stopped for the ear under the roof; the hand came down on the river's next low note and the count went forward exact and unspent into Day 228, Grain 19, Ninthday, with Grain 20 two mornings off.
